basics.name: Yohsuke Fukai

basics.summary: An experimentalist in the field of biophysics and nonequilibrium physics. I am interested in understanding 1) physical mechanisms behind information processing of cells such as cell-type specific gene expression and 2) universal descriptions in nonequilibrium physics.
